subject: Helios: Data deletion workflow & audit trail Q&A
messages:
From: Compliance Team <compliance@heliosfin.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: SOC2 evidence: deletion controls and audit trail

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — Helios is wrapping up our SOC2 renewal prep and we have a short list of artifacts we need from vendors that process customer data. For Redwood specifically we need evidence tied to deletion and retention controls for the tenant-level data path. Our list (please tell us if any of these are out of scope):

- Confirmation of data residency/enforced region for tenant eu-prod-52 (we will need the region and the storage locations).
- Technical description of the deletion workflow (what 'delete' does in the app vs background jobs).
- Sample audit trail showing deletion events for a tenant (timestamp, object id, actor, job id).
- Proof that backups and cross-region replicas are removed or TTL'd within the retention window after a deletion (describe mechanism).
- Evidence of process for handling customer erasure requests (SLA, verification, logs).
- Any controls around key management or data encryption that affect deletion (KMS policies, ability to decrypt backups).

Attached is the Helios request PDF with line items. Can you confirm scope and expected delivery date? Our deadline for inclusion in the audit package is 2025-11-27.

Thanks,
Olga Ramos
Senior Compliance Manager
Helios Financial
(compliance@heliosfin.com)

Attachment: Helios_Soc2_Request_2025-11.pdf
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Olga Ramos <olga.ramos@heliosfin.com>, Compliance Team <compliance@heliosfin.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 10:01:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence: deletion controls and audit trail

Hi Olga — thanks for the detailed list and the PDF. We can provide the majority of the artifacts you requested. Quick confirmation/questions:

- eu-prod-52: we host tenant data in the EU region (Frankfurt, eu-central-1) and object storage is in a single region; metadata indices are in the same region.
- Deletion workflow: there are two paths — immediate logical tombstone (user-facing delete) and an asynchronous purge job that runs daily for 7 days. We will provide the runbook screenshots and the purge job code pointers.
- Backups/replicas: daily snapshots are retained for 30 days; cross-region DR snapshots are on a 14-day TTL. We will provide S3 lifecycle policy and a sample logs extract showing a purge of a snapshot.
- KMS: all objects are encrypted with customer-tenant keys; key rotation does not prevent object deletion — we will include KMS policy excerpts.

We plan to deliver a packet by EOD Monday (2025-11-24) to give you time before your 11/27 deadline. Is that acceptable?

Deliverables we'll include: redwood_deletion_runbook_v1.3.pdf, s3-lifecycle-policy.json, deletion-audit-log-sample.csv, and a short narrative mapping each Helios request to artifacts. Some items will be redacted (tenant ids masked) per our privacy rules; we'll call out the redactions.

I'll loop in Irene and Marcus to pull the logs.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Liaison
Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 11:26:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence: deletion controls and audit trail (internal)

Soojin / Marcus — internal runbook for evidence pull below (assigned INF-4382). Notes:

1) Audit logs: we can pull deletion events from the tokenized-audit stream (kafka topic audit.deleted). Need to run the aggregation with tenant filter and scrub PII. Expected extract: csv with columns (event_ts, tenant_id_masked, object_key_hash, actor, purge_job_id). Sample will be included.

2) Purge job: job runs nightly at 02:15 UTC; job id format purge-YYYYMMDD-HHMM. We should include a small snippet of the purge job logs (no raw payloads).

3) Backups/replication: S3 snapshots use lifecycle rule rule-archive-30d and replication-to-eu-dr (14d TTL). Marcus: please export the lifecycle JSON and a recent replica deletion event if available.

4) KMS: provide key policy excerpt showing delete permissions and key disablement timeline. Note: for customer-managed keys we cannot export keys but can show rotation and policy artifacts.

5) Redaction: Marissa, we will need legal sign-off on tenant masking approach and the templated narrative before sending externally.

Action owners / ETA:
- Marcus: lifecycle json + replica deletion event (today EOD).
- Irene: audit log sample + purge job snippet (tomorrow morning).
- Marissa: redaction & legal review (tomorrow EOD).

Irene
Director, Applied Risk Controls
Redwood Inference

Attachment mentions: deletion-audit-log-sample.csv (placeholder to be generated)
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 08:44:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence: deletion controls and audit trail (deliverable draft)

Team — attaching the artifacts I pulled: s3-lifecycle-policy.json (exported from infra), small sample entry from replication-delete-log, and a short README explaining what each file shows. Summary of key points to include in the narrative:

- S3 lifecycle rule rule-archive-30d shows expiration: 30 days after creation for snapshots; rule is applied at prefix tenant-snapshots/eu-prod-52/.
- Cross-region replication configured to replicate to eu-dr-1 with replication rule that includes DeleteMarkerReplication: false; however we also run a separate retention-sync process that ensures deleted snapshots are removed from DR within 14 days; replication-delete-log.csv contains one example of a DR cleanup event (2025-10-12).
- Purge job snippet (redacted) shows job id purge-20251121-0215 completed and removed 42 object_keys for masked tenant_id.

I am attaching: s3-lifecycle-policy.json, replication-delete-log.csv, and a short readme. I also included the command lines used to extract the logs for auditability.

Attachments: s3-lifecycle-policy.json; replication-delete-log.csv; extraction-commands.txt

Marcus Lin
Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Olga Ramos <olga.ramos@heliosfin.com>, Compliance Team <compliance@heliosfin.com>

Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 14:38:00 -05:00
Subject: Delivering: Deletion workflow artifacts (Helios request)

Olga / Helios team —

Thanks for your patience. Attached is the evidence packet that maps to the Helios SOC2 deletion/retention items:

- redwood_deletion_runbook_v1.3.pdf — operational description of logical delete vs purge and job schedule.
- s3-lifecycle-policy.json — exported lifecycle rule for tenant snapshots (shows 30d expiration).
- deletion-audit-log-sample.csv — redacted sample of audit events (columns: event_ts, tenant_id_masked, object_key_hash, actor, purge_job_id).
- replication-delete-log.csv — example DR cleanup event showing cross-region snapshot removal.
- README_exhibit.md — narrative that maps each Helios item to the attached artifact and explains redactions/limitations.

Redaction notes and limitations:
- We have masked tenant ids in the audit CSV to preserve customer privacy while preserving event traceability.
- For backups and DR we can show lifecycle rules and delete events; we cannot provide raw backup contents or encryption keys.
- KMS policy excerpts are available on request; we have included the relevant policy identifiers in the README and can provide a signed policy extract if required by your auditor.

Next steps: if Helios wants a short walkthrough with our SRE and Compliance owners (Irene and Marcus) we can arrange a 30–45 minute call next week to go through the artifacts and answer auditor questions. Please confirm an available window.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_deletion_runbook_v1.3.pdf; s3-lifecycle-policy.json; deletion-audit-log-sample.csv; replication-delete-log.csv; README_exhibit.md
